publication_blockers: working_tree_dirty: git working tree contains uncommitted or untracked files; commit or stash before an official publication run
policy: Publication readiness is stricter than analytical run success. An analytical run may complete as SUCCESS_WITH_WARNINGS with a dirty working tree, but a run intended for official publication requires a clean working tree so the git commit alone identifies the code that produced the numbers, plus a passing data gate, an available headline model, cutoff integrity, and preserved upstream artifacts.
